excluded: Not all ICMP or full host: fixed unicast raw profile; no errors/client/options/fragments/routing/ARP or real peer evidence

ECHO-PROFILE.interpretation: Finite atomic raw IPv4 Echo responder; short input drop is profile choice; unsupported headers/types remain model_gap.

ECHO-REPLY.interpretation: Reverse addresses, type0/code0, unchanged identifier/sequence and all data; recompute checksum including odd zero pad for arithmetic only.

ECHO-HOST.interpretation: Echo server and same specific-destination source/data preservation, within declared unicast profile only.

IP-LENGTH.interpretation: Exact raw datagram length in this nonfragmented IHL5 profile.

IP-CHECKSUM.interpretation: Verify IPv4 header checksum and silently discard invalid datagram.

ICMP-CHECKSUM.interpretation: Validate ones-complement checksum over complete ICMP message; no UDP absent/zero remapping. Invalid admitted message silently discarded by profile policy.

IP-ATOMIC.interpretation: DF1/MF0/off0: input ID ignored for semantics but checked by checksum; output atomic ID0 profile choice.
